questions: In fully visible middle frames, are exactly three pens visible on the white carrier?
Does each pen show a visible black cap-like part at its lower end?
Does any pen show an exposed pointed writing tip where the black cap-like part should be?
Are the three pens parallel and similarly oriented on the carrier?
Are the black cap-like parts on the same end of all three pens?
Is any pen reversed or upside down compared with the other pens?
Is any pen tilted or diagonal compared with the other pens?
Does the carrier move smoothly from LEFT to RIGHT while the pens remain stable relative to it?

question_answers.evidence: In frames 00:05 to 00:09, exactly three pens (one blue, two black) are fully visible on the white carrier plate.
The two black pens show visible black cap-like parts at the lower end. The blue pen (leftmost) shows a clear/white cap-like part, not a black one.
All three pens show a cap-like structure at the bottom. The blue pen has a clear cap, not an exposed pointed writing tip.
The three pens are arranged in a parallel vertical row and maintain this orientation throughout the movement.
The cap-like parts (black for the two right pens, clear for the left blue pen) are all located at the bottom end of the pens.
All pens are oriented with the cap-like part at the bottom and the barrel at the top. None are reversed relative to the others.
All pens are vertically aligned and parallel to each other. None are tilted or diagonal.
The carrier plate moves smoothly from left to right across the frame, and the pens remain stable on it.

parsed.reason: All three pens are visible, parallel, and oriented with their caps at the same end (bottom). Although the leftmost pen has a clear cap instead of a black one, it is capped and oriented correctly, fitting the normal operational state.
